extracted.stage: Pre-grant; grant of probate expected in about 7 weeks
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a St Albans estate valued at around £651,000 seeks £63,500 to cover inheritance tax and legal fees pending the grant of probate.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for the executors of the St Albans estate. We have noted the estate value of approximately £651,000, the requested amount of £63,500, and that the grant of probate is anticipated in around seven weeks. To take this further we would need confirmation of the executors' details and their authority, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, the inheritance tax position including any payment deadline, details of any existing charges over the property, and a copy of the will. Please also confirm your firm's role and contact details for correspondence. Once we have those materials a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
